prompt: One of the most underrated products in a man’s
response:
40s (or 20s or whatever) bathroom would have to be the toothbrush. When we started using our ‘Old Man Toothpaste,’ we immediately noticed how much worse our gums felt — not to mention what kind of stains our brushes leave when we use them.
Here’s how brushing less can make your skin clear up.
Toothpaste: Go for one with fluoride. Yes, it dries your mouth out — but that is an unpleasant side effect of the toothpaste. Fluoride does help stop tooth decay over time. Plus, your tongue will thank you when you aren’t brushing for hours (which we all do). Check out the product lineup for this one here.
Rinse: Stay away from bottled water or carbonated drinks. Carbonation strips off healthy bacteria. Don’t feel guilty about drinking diet sodas. The flavor has been proven to not harm us. Stay away, however, from fruit juices. Fruits ferment fast in your mouth — turning into sugars that your teeth hate.
